title: CeeDee Lamb on George Pickens' long-term Cowboys future: '@Jerry, can you please figure out a way?'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: CeeDee Lamb on George Pickens' long-term Cowboys future: '@Jerry, can you please figure out a way?'
sources.description: The 2026 season will offer necessary data points for that decision. But after the sides did not negotiate toward a long-term deal ahead of the July 15 deadline, it's worth asking: Is there a ticking clock on Dallas' offense as constructed?
